recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male subject in a dark denim jacket and tie, positioned against a white painted brick wall. The composition uses a strong horizontal red band at the bottom and large, weathered sans-serif typography that overlaps the subject and the background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning forward to create depth against the flat brick texture
Textured typography interacting with the red horizontal color block
Color coordination between the dark blue denim and the navy secondary text
Thin geometric line accents framing the upper right corner
coreInvariants: Dark indigo denim jacket with visible stitching
Heavy distressing/weathering on the primary display text
Solid red horizontal band across the bottom third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the left half of the frame, medium-close-up scale, leaning slightly toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, distressed white text at the bottom serves as the primary anchor, grounded by the red band.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the vertical line of the tie to the large name text, then up to the secondary title text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space on the right side of the brick wall to accommodate secondary text and graphic lines.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark Indigo (denim jacket and secondary text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Red (horizontal band and patterned tie)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the bright white wall and the dark, saturated tones of the clothing and red band.

letterConstructionRules: Large-scale capitals for the primary name
Medium-weight strokes with heavy grunge/stamp texture applied as a mask
Secondary text is clean, untextured, and smaller in scale
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are slightly tracked out to fill the width of the frame
Texture is inconsistent across letters to mimic worn paint
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same typeface family used in two different weights and treatments (textured vs. clean).
graphicDevices: Thin curved white line in top right
Subtle vertical blue line on the far right edge

preserve: Heavy distressing on the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric structure matches the clean, modern country aesthetic.
Open counters and wide stance provide a similar footprint.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a man in a dark blue denim jacket, white shirt, and patterned red tie leaning forward against a white-painted brick wall. The bottom third of the image is covered by a solid, slightly textured red horizontal band.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large uppercase sans-serif text across the bottom, overlapping the man and the red band; apply a heavy white grit/weathered texture to this text. Add smaller, clean navy blue uppercase text in the upper right quadrant.

verificationChecks: Text at the bottom must have a 'stamped' or 'eroded' look.
The red band must be a solid block of color at the bottom.
The subject must be partially obscured by the large foreground text.
The brick wall texture must remain visible through the white paint.

adjustableVariables: Height of the red horizontal band
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Any specific brand logos on the jacket buttons

avoid: Generic 'grunge' filters that look like digital noise
Poorly integrated text that looks like a simple sticker

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text texture does not look like a repeating pattern.
Verify the red band is perfectly horizontal.
Check that the navy text is legible against the white brick.
Confirm the subject's pose feels natural and not stiff.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured architectural background with a high-contrast color block footer, using distressed geometric sans-serif type to bridge the two elements.
